questions.q: At 10 m the wind is 7 m/s, open terrain. Roughly how much at 100 m?
options: 7 m/s — wind does not depend on height
about 14 m/s — twice as much
about 9.7 m/s
about 5 m/s — the wind is weaker higher up

questions.q: The report has no gusts. What do you allow for?
options: A factor of 1.3–1.5 over the mean wind
No gusts — fly by the mean
Half the mean wind
Exactly +2 m/s on top of any wind
questions.explain: The mean wind is not the maximum; without data, use 1.3–1.5.

questions.q: Which way do you fly first in wind?
options: Downwind, to get there faster
Across the wind, it's a shorter path
The direction does not affect the return time
Into the wind, so you come back downwind
questions.explain: On the way back the battery is weaker — let the wind help.

questions.q: A site at 2000 m, +30 °C. The density altitude is roughly?
options: about 3000 m
about 1000 m
about 5000 m

questions.q: How does hover power change when density falls?
options: It grows as 1/√ρ
It falls in proportion to density
It does not change for the same mass
It grows in proportion to 1/ρ²

questions.q: Why does a cold LiPo “die” right after takeoff?
options: It has fewer cells in the cold
The flight controller measures wrong in frost
Its internal resistance grows
The cold drains it in a minute
questions.explain: The voltage sag under load grows; batteries are warmed to 20–25 °C.

questions.q: Which conditions bring a risk of prop icing?
options: Dry frost at −25 °C with no clouds
Fog or drizzle around 0 °C
Heat and strong wind in summer
A clear day at +10 °C
questions.explain: Visible moisture and a temperature from roughly +2 to −10 °C.

questions.q: What does 27012G22KT mean in a METAR?
options: Wind 270 m/s with gusts of 22
Visibility 27 km, clouds 12
Temperature 27, dew point 12
From the west at 12 knots, gusts 22 knots
questions.explain: Direction 270°, speed 12 knots, gusts 22 knots (≈ 6 and 11 m/s).
